subject: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks for sending the Partner Center referral dump yesterday. I attached the CSV export and an initial mapping proposal (see attachments). We ran a quick pass and flagged ~120 referrals that are either duplicated across referrals, missing tenant/account mapping, or have no assigned AE in Partner Center. A few are high-ACV opportunities that need field seller alignment quickly.

Goals for today:
- Confirm what fields in your export are canonical for tenant/account linkage (MPN/tenant ID/customer tenant domain)
- Agree on triage buckets and owner assignment rules so we can push a HubSpot owner sync
- Decide if Microsoft can run a dedupe/mapping job on our behalf (would need Partner Center read access or a joint report)

My suggested triage buckets (attached sheet includes examples):
1) Assign immediately to regional AE (ARR estimate > $250k or active procurement)
2) Assign to SDR/Shared AE for nurture (SMB/low ARR or unknown readiness)
3) Needs mapping / follow-up (missing tenant ID or mismatched account)
4) Duplicate / merge (multiple referrals pointing to same tenant)

Ask: Priya, can you confirm the partner_export fields and whether Microsoft can run a mapping job against your tenant registry? If not, Marcus will run our local matching script.

I propose a 30-minute sync at 11:00 PT if folks are available — propose calendar slot attached in the Teams link.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Attachments: PC_referrals_export_20260829.csv, mapping-proposal_v1.xlsx

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael O'Neal <michael.oneal@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear notes and the export. Quick answers first:
- The canonical fields for tenant matching we can provide are: Azure AD tenant ID, Tenant domain, and MPN ID. We also include an internal referral id (referral_id) in the export.
- We can run a dedupe/mapping pass on our side but we need a scoped view: either grant Partner Center read access to a service principal or we can schedule a data job where you share PII-free tenant identifiers.

I've attached our short guide on referral exports (pc-referral-guidance.pdf). If you prefer, we can run the dedupe job and return a mapping file by EOD tomorrow.

As for a sync, 11:00 PT works for me. Suggest agenda: 10 min export fields & mapping approach, 10 min triage buckets and priority rules, 10 min next steps & ownership.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Partner Program Manager, Microsoft Azure Marketplace
Attachments: pc-referral-guidance.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 09:42 Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com> wrote:
> Hi Neha — thanks for the clear notes and the export...

Thanks all — quick operational proposal from field sales perspective:

Priority rules (to convert into routing logic):
- High priority: ARR estimate >= $250k OR Contoso/Strategic logos OR active procurement signal in referral notes -> assign to Regional Enterprise AE (owner set in Partner Center if present, otherwise assign to "regional-enterprise-rotor")
- Mid priority: ARR 50k-249k OR product-fit confirmed but no procurement signal -> assign to Shared AE (region-based pool)
- Low priority: ARR <50k or no fit signal -> SDR nurture / marketing engagement

Edge cases:
- If referral has no tenant ID but email domain matches existing contact in HubSpot, prefer HubSpot owner sync rather than opening new owner assignment.
- Duplicates: if two referrals map to same tenant, keep the referral with the latest activity timestamp and merge the rest (we'll flag in a merged_referrals.csv).

Operational asks for Marcus: can you add a column in your mapping output for proposed_owner (internal id) and hubspot_company_id so we can bulk-assign? Also add a reason_code column (ARR_EST, NO_TENANT, DUPLICATE).

I can lead the routing policy doc and push to the ops repo once we confirm fields.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Field Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 10:05 Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks all — quick operational proposal from field sales perspective...

Agree with Vanessa's buckets. A couple of notes on automation:
- We should prefer HubSpot owner when there is a company match. I'll drop a saved filter here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/companies?filters=partner_center_referral which returns companies with referral_id in the PC export.
- For missing owner fallback, propose a "field-on-call" rota (regional) that receives notifications via HubSpot task assignment and a shared mailbox. That avoids immediate owner churn.
- Also recommend a daily job that: imports Partner Center export -> attempts tenant-only match -> attempts domain-based HubSpot match -> writes proposed_owner/hubspot_company_id/reason_code. Marcus, can you run this and push to the shared Drive link?

If Microsoft can run the dedupe and return tenant IDs, that will cut our false-negative rate by ~70%.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
GTM Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@microsoft.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral triage and account-owner mapping

On Sun, Aug 30, 2026 at 10:40 Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Agree with Vanessa's buckets. A couple of notes on automation...

I'll take the first pass. Plan:
1) Run the matching script against PC_referrals_export_20260829.csv and output pc-mapping-run-20260830.csv (attached). Columns: referral_id, tenant_id_proposed, hubspot_company_id, proposed_owner, reason_code.
2) Create HubSpot import ticket and add the proposed_owner/hubspot_company_id mapping so CS can bulk-assign. Ticket link will be added to the Drive doc.
3) If Microsoft provides deduped tenant file, I'll rerun and reconcile (prefer their mapping).

I've attached the initial run. Early notes: ~38 rows flagged as NO_TENANT, ~25 duplicates merged into 10 canonical tenants, and 12 high-priority referral rows with estimated ARR >250k.

I'll join the 11:00 PT sync and bring the mapping CSV.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Systems Integration Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pc-mapping-run-20260830.csv
